memo.summary: Context-only committee read: the world state is MIXED with a low-confidence transitioning Q1 label, broad equity breadth and calm credit/vol on one side, versus a 64.8 growth-scare caution reading, restrictive rising real yields, strengthening dollar, hollow liquidity composition, broken AI leadership, and bonds/FX divergence on the other. This supports uncertainty and selective de-escalation, not a new signal. Factor intelligence is not mature: only 11 panel dates, no scorecard survivors, composite IC is negative, and Pair G remains dormant. Kernel estimates leave every reviewed engine unarmed; recent board outcomes cannot be treated as proof because pooled-versus-equal gates were held or vacuous. The spine query was capped and dominated by repeated Canada-board context rows, limiting family-level decay inference.
what_fired: Growth-scare radar at caution (64.8), but only one unconfirmed, non-era-robust leg and no broad-tape context gate.
Cross-asset contradiction: bonds/FX versus equity regime, with 50% agreement.
Briefing demand-versus-supply divergences and seven buy-lane names with rising put skew; both remain display-only de-escalation context.
Master-brain thesis conflicts requiring review: China overweight versus Q3/contracting/forced-deleveraging context; long Treasuries near a stated real-yield falsifier.
memo.contradictions_review: Three current contradiction records were reviewed. The strongest macro tension is healthy equity breadth/Q1 framing against bonds-FX divergence, restrictive real yields, dollar strength, and neutral-hollow liquidity. The briefing divergence record confirms internal directional opposition but does not identify a validated aggregate edge. Rising put skew on seven buy-lane names is de-escalation-only because the bullish skew-deceleration prior is unsupported. No factor Pair G contradictions exist because the panel has not reached the required 60 dates. Open master-brain theses are internally inconsistent on China: both overweight and underweight theses remain open, with several check-by dates already passed; these require ledger hygiene rather than directional adjudication.

deserves_operator: Review cross-asset/equity divergence under the pre-committed 70%-agreement clearing criterion; do not convert it into a position.
Review China overweight thesis mb-2026-07-09-1 against current Q3, contracting liquidity, forced deleveraging/fire-sale participation, and weak-side HK peg.
Review long-Treasury thesis mb-2026-07-01-1 before its 2026-07-29 check-by: real 10-year yield is 2.44%, close to its 2.50% falsifier, while the curve is bear-steepening.
Reconcile mutually opposed open China theses and score or retire theses whose check-by dates have passed.
Keep cortex attention in shadow probation: current evidence is insufficient for A2 authority.
